name: Volumetric Radiance Estimators
definition: A family of nine distinct volumetric radiance estimators introduced by Jarosz et al. [2011a] that differ in the representation of equilibrium radiance, the radiometric quantities estimated, and the dimension of blur used to reconstruct the desired quantity from samples. They are evaluated on segments along light and eye subpaths.
summary: Volumetric Radiance Estimators are nine methods that estimate equilibrium radiance in participating media by reconstructing values from discrete samples using spatial blurring, differing from unbiased path integral estimators by lacking a general path contribution function and pdf.
